title: Assistant Designer, Accessories
note: Assistant-level design role for bags, belts, small leather goods, hats and gifting at a western boot and leather goods brand.

facts.summary: Assistant designer supporting the Design Director across Tecovas accessories categories.
facts.duties: Research trends, sketch concepts, make technical drawings and tech packs, keep design files and samples organized, work with product development, travel to factories and trade shows.
facts.requirements: Design bachelor's or equivalent experience; strong hand sketching; Adobe Illustrator for CADs; tech pack skills; PLM a plus; must live in or move to Austin.
facts.apply: Apply online through Tecovas' Greenhouse page.
